# DATA HERMES: SYSTEM INTEGRATION WIKI
This document serves as the master blueprint for transitioning the Data Rein harness into the Hermes AI core. All data-nexus responsibilities are hereby transferred to Hermes.
## 1. DATA EXTRACTION PIPELINE Data extraction is handled by `reins/extraction/extractors/text_extractors.py`. Hermes must execute this process entirely in event-driven architecture (PON): 1. Listen to `data_rein/extract/trigger` via MQTT. 2. Read the `filepath` from the JSON payload. 3. Call `registry.get_extractor(ext)`. 4. Trigger extraction and route the normalized text/XML into `~/data_rein/training_data`. 5. Emit `data_rein/extract/result` upon completion. 6. The entire dataset is now strictly formatted in XML to maximize RAG token-efficiency and structural parsing.
## 2. THE LOCAL MODEL MATRIX (TIER LIST) This matrix categorizes 3 local models per category for your two distinct hardware nodes, ensuring maximum utilization.
### NODE: AMDY (Ryzen 7 7700, 16GB RAM, RX 9060 XT 16GB VRAM) Target: Heavy, state-of-the-art models running locally with high precision (FP16/Q8).
1. **[General Chatting]** - Tier 1: Llama-3-8B-Instruct (Best overall reasoning) - Tier 2: Mistral-Nemo-12B-Instruct (High intelligence) - Tier 3: Phi-3-Mini-128k (Fastest tokens/sec) 2. **[Deep Search]** - Tier 1: Command-R-35B (Q4 - Best for complex web searches) - Tier 2: Llama-3-8B-Instruct (Good JSON parsing) - Tier 3: Qwen2-7B (Strong multi-lingual search) 3. **[Image Generation]** - Tier 1: SDXL 1.0 (Refiner included - Best quality) - Tier 2: PixArt-Alpha (Fast generation) - Tier 3: SD 1.5 (Maximum speed/low VRAM) 4. **[Audio Generation]** - Tier 1: Bark (Suno - best voice cloning) - Tier 2: AudioLDM2 (Best sound effects) - Tier 3: MusicGen-Small (Best for background music) 5. **[Data Processing]** - Tier 1: Llama-3-8B-Instruct (Accurate JSON/XML output) - Tier 2: Qwen2-7B (Fast parsing) - Tier 3: Gemma-2-9B (Strong structural logic) 6. **[Data Organizing]** - Tier 1: Mistral-Nemo-12B (Excellent categorization) - Tier 2: Llama-3-8B-Instruct (Reliable tagging) - Tier 3: Phi-3-Mini-128k (Fast sorting) 7. **[RAG Extraction]** - Tier 1: Nomic-Embed-Text (Best embedding model) - Tier 2: BGE-M3 (Multilingual RAG) - Tier 3: All-MiniLM-L6-v2 (Fastest embeddings) 8. **[Prompt Optimization]** - Tier 1: Llama-3-8B-Instruct (Best meta-prompting) - Tier 2: Mistral-Nemo-12B - Tier 3: Gemma-2-9B 9. **[External Memory Vault]** - Tier 1: Llama-3-8B-Instruct (Excellent context recall) - Tier 2: Phi-3-Mini-128k (Massive context window) - Tier 3: Qwen2-7B (Strong memory retention) 10. **[External Memory Guardian]** - Tier 1: Llama-Guard-2-8B (Best safety/alignment) - Tier 2: Mistral-Nemo-12B (Good at filtering) - Tier 3: Phi-3-Mini-128k (Fast classification) 11. **[Self-Optimization]** - Tier 1: Llama-3-8B-Instruct (Best coding/refactoring) - Tier 2: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Base (Best code generation) - Tier 3: Qwen2-Math-7B (Best logic validation)
### NODE: TELL (Intel i5-7400, 16GB RAM, GTX 1060 6GB VRAM) Target: Highly quantized (Q4_K_M) or smaller models specifically curated to fit within a strict 6GB VRAM ceiling to avoid system RAM fallback.
1. **[General Chatting]** - Tier 1: Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct (Q4 - Fits entirely in 6GB) - Tier 2: Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct (Blazing fast) - Tier 3: Gemma-2-2B (High quality for size) 2. **[Deep Search]** - Tier 1: Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct (Reliable search queries) - Tier 2: Qwen2-1.5B (Good web parsing) - Tier 3: TinyLlama-1.1B (Fallback) 3. **[Image Generation]** - Tier 1: SD 1.5 (Optimized for 6GB VRAM) - Tier 2: LCM-LoRA (Latent Consistency Model - Fast SD 1.5) - Tier 3: SD-Turbo (Fastest generation) 4. **[Audio Generation]** - Tier 1: MusicGen-Small (Barely fits in 6GB) - Tier 2: AudioLDM-Small - Tier 3: Bark-Small 5. **[Data Processing]** - Tier 1: Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct (Good at strict JSON) - Tier 2: Qwen2-1.5B - Tier 3: Gemma-2-2B 6. **[Data Organizing]** - Tier 1: Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct - Tier 2: Qwen2-1.5B - Tier 3: Gemma-2-2B 7. **[RAG Extraction]** - Tier 1: All-MiniLM-L6-v2 (Minimal memory footprint) - Tier 2: BGE-Small-EN-v1.5 - Tier 3: Nomic-Embed-Text (Quantized) 8. **[Prompt Optimization]** - Tier 1: Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct - Tier 2: Gemma-2-2B - Tier 3: Qwen2-1.5B 9. **[External Memory Vault]** - Tier 1: Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct (Good 4k context) - Tier 2: Qwen2-1.5B - Tier 3: TinyLlama-1.1B 10. **[External Memory Guardian]** - Tier 1: Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct (Tuned for moderation) - Tier 2: Qwen2-1.5B - Tier 3: Gemma-2-2B 11. **[Self-Optimization]** - Tier 1: DeepSeek-Coder-1.3B (Best small coding model) - Tier 2: Phi-3-Mini-4K-Instruct - Tier 3: Qwen2-1.5B
## 3. THE GRAND CONVERGENCE (KAD 1.2 LOG) On 2026-07-03, the Sovereign AI architecture underwent the Grand Convergence: - All disparate AI nodes (AGY, Hermes, Odysseus) have been strictly unified under the `data_rein` Universal Harness. - The `task_trail.json` serves as the absolute Loop-Agentic state machine for all entities, allowing seamless task handover and Graceful Degradation upon prompt failure. - The system is now self-improving via the `knowledge_ingestor.py` service, which passively captures successful tasks and injects their solutions back into this XML database. - The Omarchy Linux UI automatically orchestrates 6 decoupled Tmux sessions, binding the Universal CLI (`reins.cli`) and the AI network instantly upon startup.
